title: Elodie and the Crown
author: Coral Kavanagh
blurb: Juniper Crane, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
